ai.demoBannerPre: Demo mode: replies on this page are preset samples, no model is called. The API endpoint
ai.welcome: Hi! I'm Xiaoyu, your AI growth companion combining five AI roles. I can help you record milestones, analyze emotions, and offer parenting advice. What would you like to know?
ai.fallbackReply: Interesting question — let me analyze it for you.
ai.footerTagline: Born from love, guarded with care

all.name: All Roles
all.greeting: Hi! I'm Xiaoyu AI, combining five roles to help you. How can I help?
all.r1: Overall, your baby's growth needs well-rounded attention. Balance health, emotional and cognitive development.
all.r2: As your AI assistant, I've combined advice from all five roles. Remember: scientific parenting takes patience.
all.r3: Analyzing from multiple dimensions, your current parenting approach is solid. Keep going and adjust as your baby grows.

recorder.name: Recorder
recorder.greeting: Hi! I'm the Recorder, here to track your baby's growth data.
recorder.r1: I've logged this important info. Update your baby's development data regularly so I can track trends better.
recorder.r2: Done recording! Based on your description, keep an eye on this stage's milestone indicators.
recorder.r3: Saved. Consistent records are key to understanding your baby's growth trajectory.

guardian.name: Guardian
guardian.greeting: Hi! I'm the Guardian, focused on your baby's health and safety.
guardian.r1: From a safety standpoint, make sure your baby's play area is properly protected.
guardian.r2: Health and safety come first. Keep vaccinations and check-ups on schedule.
guardian.r3: A reminder from your Guardian: keep the sleep environment safe and avoid soft bedding.

listener.name: Listener
listener.greeting: Hi! I'm the Listener, here to hear you out.
listener.r1: I understand your worries as a parent. Every child grows at their own pace — your patience and love matter most.
listener.r2: It's clear you care deeply about your baby's growth. You're a great parent, and your baby feels it.
listener.r3: Your feelings matter. Doubts are normal on the parenting journey — I'm here whenever you need support.

advisor.name: Advisor
advisor.greeting: Hi! I'm the Advisor, here with professional parenting tips.
advisor.r1: Based on the latest research, shared reading and interactive games greatly benefit your baby's brain development.
advisor.r2: Professionally speaking, a regular routine is key to healthy growth and development.
advisor.r3: Try more eye contact with your baby — it helps build a secure attachment.

cultural.name: Culture Mentor
cultural.greeting: Hi! I'm the Culture Mentor, focused on cultural enlightenment.
cultural.r1: Start music enlightenment with simple nursery rhymes — great for language and rhythm development.
cultural.r2: Spend time daily with picture books to nurture early reading interest.
cultural.r3: Begin cultural enlightenment with simple Tang poems — babies love the beauty of the language.
